jobs.mustProve: Current fields, conditional goal, ordered timeline, absent task/progress semantics.
Provenanced topology, coverage gaps, bounded workflow, separate schedule.
Mock runner, configured backend attestation, ordered-replay precondition.
Candidate order, fallback, deny-closed execution, exact provider/version matrix.
Signed pull plus real host before/after state for every promoted delivery path.
Canonical/rendered set equality and accepted evidence for every Built alias.

evidenceFormat.note: No artifact carrying every required field at the exact refs means the claim cannot be accepted. Its absence does not block publishing the claim honestly as implemented_unaccepted.

claims.title: Live operations and sessions
claims.boundedProposition: See observed current action, model, tokens, cost and timeline. A goal appears only when reported; task and progress tracking are not yet promoted.
conditions: The session schema records current action, model, tokens, cost and event/timeline data.
A goal is present only when the source reports it.
unpromoted: Task tracking: no canonical WorkItem type is declared anywhere in modules, core, sdk, web or cmd/olivares at the measured ref.
Computed progress: no task-derived progress invariant exists, so progress cannot be claimed.
Handoff: no canonical Handoff type is declared at the measured ref.
gaps: modules/sessions/live_test.go is a component test of ingestion and observable state; it does not bind the public sentence, its route, its conditions, exact refs, a mutant or retained evidence.

claims.title: Agent communication and orchestration
claims.boundedProposition: Visualise observed Claude Task, MCP and A2A delegation topology with explicit coverage gaps. Governed schedules and bounded workflows are separate controls.
conditions: Coverage is an explicit DTO field, not an implicit promise.
Workflow graph verbs are bounded and enumerated.
Delegation topology is observed, not governed end to end.
unpromoted: End-to-end governed coordination: no canonical cross-session Task/Handoff/Ack state machine exists at the measured ref.
A single workflow tying delegation, completion and acknowledgement: schedules, workflows and topology are separate mechanisms.
gaps: Graph tests prove nodes, edges and coverage behaviour; they do not bind the public sentence to a route, conditions, exact refs, a mutant or retained evidence.

claims.title: Simulation sandbox
claims.boundedProposition: Run operator-authored mock scenarios in an isolated ephemeral runner. Configured gVisor/Firecracker backends attest OS isolation; ordered replay requires ordered history. Real agent execution and synthetic generation are unpromoted.
conditions: Default behaviour is operator-authored mock scenario execution.
OS isolation exists only when the OS runner is configured in composition.
Ordered replay depends on an ordered history source.
unpromoted: Real-agent execution: no proved real-agent run at the measured ref.
Synthetic data generation: no generator was traced.
Scenario lifecycle in the UI: the console client exposes run/replay/compare but no create/archive.
Non-production network/credential proof.
gaps: No backend attestation is recorded, so promoted gVisor/Firecracker isolation has no evidence artifact at any ref.

claims.title: Models, providers and routing
claims.boundedProposition: Define cost, latency, capability or pinned policies and resolve an ordered fallback chain. /execute is deny-closed unless a Claude Messages-compatible credential or gateway is configured; local/provider-wide actuation and secret custody are unpromoted.
conditions: Policy resolution produces an ordered candidate chain.
/execute is a separate deny-closed path and stays closed without a configured actuator.
The only composed actuator is Claude Messages-compatible.
unpromoted: Universal hosted/local execution: origin/main has zero cmd/olivares imports or composition cases for connectors/openai, connectors/gemini, Ollama or vLLM.
Centralised key custody: provider key fields are references, not demonstrated central custody.
Execution from the console: the console client resolves and tests policies but has no execute call.
gaps: No provider matrix exists: every provider named by broader copy, including each local runtime, needs an executed row before promotion.

claims.title: Managed-settings delivery
claims.boundedProposition: Render managed settings locally or expose a signed artifact/configured gateway document for authenticated pull. Per-host application and fleet rollout are external and attested, never assumed.
conditions: The managed-settings connector declares a modeling-only boundary.
The CLI renders settings locally and labels that operation local.
The Apps gateway serves one configured document.
unpromoted: Fleet rollout and rollback: the truth model states agent pull and MDM rollout are outside v1.
Per-host application: the enterprise fleet seam distributes intent and attestation; it does not prove the endpoint applied the settings.
gaps: Tests prove signed artifact behaviour, not host application. Until a real MDM/Kubernetes/host adapter is exercised, copy must name pull and render, never rollout.
